children: fell more than 5% after the company reported weaker-than-expected
and issued a cautious outlook for fiscal 2027.
The company posted fourth-quarter revenue of $293.1M, down 12.9% year over year and about $0.48M below expectations. Non-GAAP loss per share came in at $0.80, missing estimates by $0.08.
Revenue declines were broad-based, with Consumer Floral & Gifts down 13.4% and Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets falling 15.4%, partly due to the timing of Easter.
Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $31M from $24.2M a year earlier.
For fiscal 2026, revenue fell 10.8% to $1.50B, while adjusted EBITDA dropped to $2.9M from $29.2M.
Looking ahead, 1-800-Flowers expects fiscal 2027 revenue to decline by a mid-single-digit percentage, while adjusted EBITDA is projected at $10M-$15M.
The company also amended its credit agreement and is evaluating debt, equity, asset sales and other capital-raising options to strengthen its balance sheet and fund its transformation.

title: 1-800-Flowers shares slide after weak Q4
